movelist.name: Tail Glow
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Attack 3 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Moonlight
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value.

movelist.name: Struggle Bug
movelist.effect: On hit, lowers the target’s Special Attack by -1 CS.

movelist.name: Double Team
movelist.effect: The user gains 3 activations of Double Team. The user may either activate Double Team when being targeted by an attack to increase their Evasion by +2 against that attack; or when making an attack to increase their Accuracy by +2 for that attack.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.effect: Attacks that target the user have a -2 Accuracy Penalty against the user. Does not affect attackers with the Blindsense Capability. Defensive.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the Enraged and Infatuated conditions. Defensive.
